about_the_game:
This KOREAN Theme DLC features two new stages inspired by traditional Korean culture and folklore.

At dawn, under the silver moonlight, embark on a journey through the mystical Korean mountain trails and head toward the ancient palace.

Key Features

• Two New Stages – The moonlit mountain path and the ancient KOREAN palace.

• Traditional Korean Mechanics – New gimmicks inspired by folklore: will-o’-the-wisps, tigers, and the Grim Reaper cat.

• New Character Costume – Tori transforms into Hong Gil-dong, a legendary hero from the KOREAN Dynasty!

• Korean-Inspired Soundtrack – A modern fusion of traditional instruments such as the Gayageum and Haegeum.
